_comment: Synthetic air handler (generator ahu_sensor_bias, camber.datasets._synthetic_ahu_sensor_bias; 0.108) -> CAMBER Role mapping. Every column is CAMBER's own: OAT, RAT, MAT and SAT the outdoor, return, mixed and supply air temperatures (F), SAT_SP the supply-air setpoint (F), OA_DMPR the outdoor-air damper command (%), SA_CFM the supply airflow (cfm), HTG_VLV and CLG_VLV the heating and cooling valve commands (%), SF_STS the supply fan's run status (1 = running), OCC the occupancy point (1 = occupied). SAT_LOGGER (a duct logger's reading) is mapped by synthetic_ahu_sensor_bias_logger.json. The scenario column selects one unit per ingest run and is not a point.
